V2_target_domain_adaptation.phase_alignment_rule_fail_closed: for every on-policy trace, labels are valid only up to the FIRST discrete FSM mismatch between the rollout and the prescribed cycle (state_name/valid_hs_count/valid_to_count comparison on the exact time grid); rows after the first mismatch are TRUNCATED from the dataset; the truncated fraction is reported per trace; a round whose aggregate out-of-phase fraction before truncation exceeds 0.80 is rejected entirely (July diagnosis: 76.3% misaligned labels destroyed the adaptation; truncation, never relabelling by index)
V2_target_domain_adaptation.loss: L = mean_j E_anchor[(m_j - a_V26_j)^2]/Var_anchor_j + beta * mean_j E_teacher[(m_j - uIK_j)^2]/Var_teacher_j + lambda_phi*L_aux(prescribed clock, training-time head only) + lambda_clip*relu(|m|-1)^2 + lambda_a*||theta - theta_V1||^2; per-joint variances fixed a priori from the training rows; group-balanced per-role means (never row-count weighted); beta = 1.0 a priori
V2_target_domain_adaptation.dagger_budget: at most 3 rounds (July promoted round 2 and rejected round 3); round r+1 aggregates ONLY seed 123/124 rows of round r; every round ends with the deterministic gate V3 and an architect audit; no adaptive tuning on the gate

order: (1) eliminate every sigma failing ANY element of the battery above (fail-closed)
(2) among survivors rank FIRST by robustness count (number of the 6 runs meeting horizon AND >= 1 cycle), higher is better

(3) if tied, rank by quality margin: the vector of per-start median (knee_rmse, -knee_r, ankle_rmse, penetration_max, reserve_max) averaged over starts; smaller is better, compared with preregistered equivalence margins
(4) LARGER sigma is chosen ONLY as the final tie-break when robustness counts are equal AND every quality metric differs by less than its equivalence margin
